checkpoints.name: one_test_fails
checkpoints.description: Two tests pass and one — tx_0xFF — fails. A red bar. The instinct is 'the design is broken'; the lab is about checking that instinct.

checkpoints.name: line_idles_high
checkpoints.description: In the waveform, the serial line idles high between transmissions — the UART resting state. Confirms the waveform loads and the transmit line behaves.

cross_tool_deep_links.name: failing_test_to_waveform
cross_tool_deep_links.source_action: open the failing tx_0xFF result and debug it in the waveform
cross_tool_deep_links.expected_target_state: the transmission for 0xFF is shown; reading the serial line bit by bit reveals the DUT sent 0xFF correctly — so the failure is a wrong expectation in the testbench (it wanted 0x00), not a design bug
